summary: Kanzhun Limited (Hong Kong Stock Exchange, code 02076) filed a Form 6-K containing its Next Day Disclosure Return under HKEX Main Board Rules 13.25A. The return reports changes in issued shares for the period ended May 28, 2026, including the issuance of 9,500 new Class A ordinary shares to participants (other than directors) at USD 4.5363 per share upon exercise of share options under a share scheme. Additionally, the registrant discloses a series of share repurchases between March 20 and April 13, 2026, with repurchase prices ranging from approximately USD 6.5654 to USD 6.8164 per share, all designated for cancellation but not yet cancelled. The total number of repurchased shares outstanding (not yet cancelled) as of the closing balance date is not aggregated in the filing. Capital returns are a form of shareholder value enhancement. Watch for subsequent filings confirming cancellations and any updates to the share buyback program.
